_comment: ag3s-verifier T38 Phase A (2026-10-01): profile of the AG3S server pipeline (serve_safe SafePolicy.infer, E3b flags) on the worktree /mnt/dev/work-o4 (branch o4-gpu-parallel = tag pre-gpu-parallel-20261001). numbers and paths only.

inputs.flags: outputs/verify/T34/p/start_server_e3.sh (E3b): --esdf-backend curobo --voxel 0.020 --fine-voxel 0.005 --tsdf-voxel 0.005 --links gripper --target-field-policy exclude-authorized --esdf-margin 0 --no-self-collision --capsule-radius-scale 0.05 --sphere-spacing 0.4 --max-spheres-per-capsule 32 --record-constraints; client --safe-phase approach --safe-manipulators left
inputs.depth: re-rendered per seq from frames.jsonl planning-row qpos (T32 H4 render_real.py method), wire-quantised uint16 mm
inputs.attention: server-recorded 16x16 maps per camera (float16 in the record)
inputs.code_differences_vs_T34_server: T34 E3b ran at benchmark cee8f84 + T33/T34 edits; worktree is b4f06ec (adds T35-T37, K1 continuity gate)

runs.command: MUJOCO_GL=osmesa PYTHONPATH=/mnt/dev/work-o4 AG3S_ASSET_ROOT=/mnt/dev/work/src AG3S_CLIENT_SCRIPT=/mnt/dev/work/pi05_TO_hybrid/rby1_bringup/pi05_infer.py .venv-openpi-live/bin/python outputs/verify/T38/replay_profile.py E3b_ep1807_r2 75 --passes T,S,C,P,W,X --warm 4
runs.contamination: a foreign CPU process (.venv-curobo probe.py, ~1,400 % CPU) ran from pass S seq 69 on; pass S seq 69-75 wall 5.0-10.8 s, pass C 8.7-15 s (census also adds its own overhead). P/W/X stopped during P (kill of own pid) and re-run as _q2; partial P kept in outputs/verify/T38/contended/. pass T (all 75) ran before the probe started. load samples: outputs/verify/T38/logs/load_samples.txt

runs.alone: no foreign process > 5 % CPU, GPU 0 MiB before (load_pre_q2.txt, logs/nvidia_smi_pre_E3b_ep1807_r2_q2.txt)

runs.tool: py-spy 0.4.2 wheel unpacked in the session scratchpad (not installed into any venv); attach by pid is denied (ptrace), so it runs as parent

baseline_check.alone: no — another session's GPU process (pid 981255, 8810 MiB, 53-58 % util) ran during both baselines (outputs/verify/T38/baseline/pre.txt, post.txt). The three baseline numbers are pre-SQP values.

numbers._comment: all ms are per planning chunk. replay = SafePolicy.infer driven with re-rendered E3b_ep1807_r2 requests (75 chunks); stats over seq 2-75 (seq 1 builds a new cuRobo mapper after reset, reported separately). quiet run = label _q2.

stage_ms.note: constraint_generation contains esdf (nested profiler stage); constraint_generation_minus_esdf = the rest. attention_lifting ~0: lifting is done inside scene_reconstruction (multiview.process_observation).

first_chunk_after_reset.note: seq 1 of every episode: AG3S.reset drops the cuRobo builder (pipeline.py:368 `_esdf_builder = None`) so the mapper is rebuilt (esdf ~1.37 s). The first chunk of a new process additionally pays warp/cuRobo JIT (esdf 6.7 s, wall 9.4 s); not quoted as steady state.

pyspy.mode: py-spy 0.4.2 record --format raw --rate 50 --nonblocking (all threads, no --idle); pass T only; wall median 3160 ms under sampling
pyspy.first_attempt: --idle --rate 200 (blocking) slowed the process >20x (first chunk 251 s); aborted, kept in outputs/verify/T38/pyspy_try1_idle_200hz_aborted/

input_sizes_census_pass_C_75_chunks.esdf_tier_note: coarse 20 mm + fine 5 mm (+ target-free fine 5 mm while not holding: _build_tiers 2 calls); 3 tiers in 62 chunks, 2 in 13 (held)

redundancy.backproject_note: 3 in scene_reconstruction (reconstruction.py:274 via multiview.process_observation) + 3 in constraint_generation (pipeline.py:1773 _robot_mask_for) on the same depth/K/T of each camera; census hash of the back-projected points identical between voxel_downsample input and the _robot_mask_for robot_sphere_mask input (e.g. seq 2 head 709a80f477aede2f, 139,044 pts)
redundancy.robot_sphere_mask_note: 3 on the voxelised per-camera cloud (scene_reconstruction) + 3 on the full-resolution back-projection (_robot_mask_for); while held (13 chunks) +3 more held-sphere masks on the same full-res points (pipeline.py:1789). Each call builds a cKDTree on all points (robot_filter.py:168) and loops in Python over 587 spheres (587 query_ball_point calls per camera, 1,761 per 3 cameras, robot_filter.py:169-172).
redundancy.kd_same_input_note: number of (chunk, array) pairs over the 75 chunks in which an identical array (blake2b of bytes) was KD-treed more than once, keyed by the sites that built it (robot_sphere_mask 39 = 13 held chunks x 3 cameras). _labels_from_sites builds a tree on the same seed points once per tier (coarse + fine); trajopt linearize.py:736 rebuilds a tree on manipulated_points on every linearize/check call (9 builds per chunk before attach) from points already KD-treed in grounding (admissibility gap / anchor_cover).
redundancy.depth_upload_note: each camera depth is uploaded to GPU twice per chunk (curobo_builder.py:815 _integrate, once for the coarse mapper and once for the fine mapper): 6 x 1,228,800 B = 7.37 MB
redundancy.per_camera_python_loops: multiview.fuse_observations list comprehension over 3 cameras (multiview.py:356); _depth_cameras_from loop over 3 cameras (pipeline.py:1957); robot_sphere_mask python loop over 587 spheres per call; grow_region while-loop over BFS waves (7-22 waves); no per-cluster loop of measurable cost (_split_groups / _score_cluster < 1 ms)

constraint_builder.build_spec: pipeline.py:1372 build_spec = primitive_path or bool(surfaces); support surfaces present in 75/75 chunks so the spec is built every chunk (5,098 parameters)
constraint_builder.reader: only trajopt/linearize.py:1250 scene_from_constraint_set -> SceneSnapshot.from_spec (linearize.py:197); serve_safe trajopt config sets collision.use_support_planes False (serve_safe.py:1335) and backend esdf, so plane_active and candidate_active are zeroed (linearize.py:1363-1374)
constraint_builder.other_readers_in_server_path: none found (to_adapter.refresh / summary / visualization are not called by serve_safe/safe_policy)

redundancy.recorder_note: SafePolicy._record (--record-constraints) runs after timing_ms.total: median 245 ms, mostly zipfile write (py-spy); not in profile_ms

host_device_copies_census.method: torch.Tensor.cpu/.to/.cuda/.item/.tolist and torch.as_tensor/torch.tensor(device=cuda) wrapped in census pass C; callsite = first benchmark/ frame

numbers.gpu_note: GPU kernel time 5.7-7.4 ms and memcpy 2.7-4.4 ms per chunk (torch.profiler CUPTI, warp kernels included); the esdf stage wall (~250 ms) is CPU-side (cProfile: _labels_from_sites np.unique/sort + cKDTree, unpack_site_linear, _build_tiers D2H). Stage medians with and without torch.cuda.synchronize at stage boundaries differ by <= 40 ms (pass S vs pass T).
numbers.to_note: TO linearize median 97 ms: ESDF gradient cache np.gradient + np.stack over each 128^3 tier on first query per chunk (esdf.py:440-442, py-spy top leaves) and cKDTree on manipulated points (linearize.py:736).
numbers.micro_note: same inputs, same result (`same_result`), only scipy cKDTree `workers` changed in a copy of grow_region inside outputs/verify/T38/micro_kdtree.py; cpu_count 256. quiet = after the foreign probe.py ended; contended = while it ran.

gpu_memory.first_run_others_mib: 8,810-10,452 total used while another session's process (pid 981255) held 8,810 MiB
gpu_memory.note: nvidia-smi --query-compute-apps does not list container pids; ours = total used when no other GPU process was present
